messages:
Maria (CS): Quick heads-up — Lodestar onboarding kickoff tomorrow 10am PT. Want to confirm stakeholders, success criteria, and a rough 30/60/90 timeline. @Jordan (PM) @Sam (Eng) @Ellie (Solutions Eng) can you chime in with owners and blockers?
Jordan (PM): Thanks — I'll own PM coordination. Stakeholders: Priya (Lodestar Product), Marco (Data), and Tanya (Ops). High-level success criteria: 1) LLM-integrated search live in staging, 2) <10% failed inference rate in test workload, 3) first 500 queries/day latency under 400ms.
Sam (Eng): For infra, we need Lodestar to confirm network access (ip ranges) and whether they want Dedicated or Hosted. If Dedicated, estimate we need GPU pool by week 3. If Hosted, we need token/key rotation plan and data retention agreement.
Ellie (Solutions Eng): Enablement plan: two 1-hour enablement sessions (devs + product) during week 1, then a troubleshooting office hour in week 2. I'll prepare sample prompts and a validation checklist. Also ask Lodestar for a small prompt set for quality baselining.
Maria (CS): Renewal/health note — Lodestar is early-stage but strategic. Flag: if model quality doesn't meet bar by day 45, renewal risk increases. Let's capture rejects and user feedback from day 1.
Jordan (PM): Timeline proposal: week 0 (this week) — access & data contract; week 1 — test integration + enablement; week 2 — validation and regressions; week 3 — pilot go/no-go and capacity decisions; week 6 — production ramp. Owners: Maria (CS) status, Sam (Eng) infra, Ellie docs/training.
Sam (Eng): Action item for Lodestar: provide sample payload schema, VPN / VPC peering requirements, and expected qps. I'll draft infra checklist. Also we should decide quantization profile for the model — any preference @Ellie?
Ellie (Solutions Eng): We'll start with fp16 then move to int8 if latency/cost tradeoffs require it. Add evaluation prompts for hallucination checks.
Maria (CS): Noted. I'll send the kickoff invite + agenda. Also capturing enablement feedback loop: short form after session (2 mins) + a follow-up triage ticket for any regressions.
OnboardBot: Checklist created — tasks: share network details, provide prompt set, grant staging access, confirm entitlement (Hosted/Dedicated). Due dates auto-set from kickoff date.
Jordan (PM): Quick Q: who owns rollback policy for the pilot? Suggest Sam (Eng) + Maria (CS) jointly.
Sam (Eng): Agree. I'll draft an emergency fallback plan to a smaller model variant and a rate-limit policy.
Maria (CS): Perfect. Final ask — confirm stakeholders' emails and a primary Slack channel at kickoff. I'll post a follow-up thread with the invite + doc links. :thumbsup:
Ellie (Solutions Eng): I'll upload the enablement slide deck and example eval prompts to the doc linked in the invite.
Maria (CS): Thanks team — see you tomorrow.
Jordan (PM): :rocket:
Sam (Eng): 👍
OnboardBot: Reminder scheduled 30m before kickoff.
